dashboardPageIds.description: Explicit dashboard page selection; empty array serializes as an empty selection.

enableOrderModule.description: Whether to enable TapOrders for the user; omitted uses provider default.

showServicesOverview.description: Service overview display preference; omission uses provider default.

showCategoriesOverview.description: Category overview display preference; omission uses provider default.

Obtain the relevant client, business unit, client group and data profile IDs before calling. Do not retry blindly if the result is uncertain; check `list-users` by email first.
